name: yoi-server
description: Server-side deployment fact store: services, releases, and the append-only event stream of one machine.

skills.name: yoi-server-store
skills.description: Manage on-server deployment facts (services, releases, events) through the yoi-server context CLI.

entities.name: service

fields.name: pack_ref
fields.description: Pack slug this service was deployed from, if any

fields.name: ports
fields.description: Declared listen ports, space or comma separated

fields.name: runtime
fields.description: Supervisor binding JSON: {kind, ...}. kind is compose|docker|podman|systemd|pm2|pidfile|socket|custom. compose needs file (+ optional project, services). docker/podman: containers. systemd: units. pm2: names. pidfile: files. socket: sockets. custom: command.

entities.description: Logical service identity. Configuration lives in frontmatter (runtime, links, ports, cpu, memory). Body is unused.

entities.name: release
entities.description: Immutable deployment intent; only status changes after creation. Create with a uuid --id. Body holds ## Plan / ## Config / ## Outcome sections with JSON fenced blocks.

entities.name: event

fields.name: service
fields.description: Service id the event belongs to

fields.name: release
fields.description: Optional release uuid this event belongs to

fields.name: kind
fields.description: Open set, e.g. deploy_started | config_change | oom_killed | custom

entities.description: Append-only fact stream; non-deployment events stay independent from releases.
